name: Planets & Colonization
summary: Overall good alignment between design and implementation. Key issues: (1) growth.ts missing - population growth system not fully implemented as separate file; (2) ColoniesScreen uses simplified production formula instead of full system; (3) Some environment modifiers slightly differ between generation-tables.md and population.ts; (4) Gaia growth modifier inconsistency resolved (design says 1.0×, population.ts correctly uses 1.0×); (5) Minor missing features around special planet bonuses and stellar converter implementation details.

matches.description: Hostile environment types correctly defined: radiated, toxic, inferno, dead, tundra, barren. HOSTILE_ENVIRONMENT_TYPES Set matches design spec.
Controlled Environment tech requirements correctly mapped in HOSTILE_ENV_REQUIRED_TECH (controlled_radiated, controlled_toxic, etc.)
Hermit Crab universal colonization ability correctly implemented via hasUniversalColonization() check
Five slider system (SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO/TECH) correctly implemented with proper allocation logic
TECH slider correctly diverts population from labor pool rather than consuming BC. allocateSliders() implements this correctly.
Factory cost base 10 BC matches design spec (factoryCostBC: 10 in DEFAULT_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT)
Base factory output 1 BC per turn matches design (BASE_FACTORY_OUTPUT = 1.0)
Base population labor output 0.5 BC correctly implemented (BASE_POP_OUTPUT_MIN = 0.5)
Mineral richness modifiers match design: ultra_poor=0.33, poor=0.50, normal=1.00, rich=2.00, ultra_rich=3.00
Robotic Controls factory ratio correctly implemented (roboticControlsLevel in ProductionContext, base value 2)
Missile base construction via DEF slider correctly implemented in processBuildingConstruction()
Planetary shields upgrade correctly implemented - checks bombardmentAbsorption value and upgrades planet.planetaryShield
Rabbits +100% population growth correctly implemented (RACIAL_GROWTH_MODIFIER rabbits: 2.00)
Ants +25% population growth correctly implemented (RACIAL_GROWTH_MODIFIER ants: 1.25)
Research multiplier for special planets (Orion 4x, Artifacts 2x) correctly applied in allocateSliders() via planet.researchMultiplier
Colony starting stats correctly defined: COLONY_STARTING_POPULATION=10, COLONY_STARTING_FACTORIES=0, COLONY_STARTING_POLLUTION=0
Slider lock functionality implemented with rebalanceSliders() algorithm matching design §7

mismatches.design_spec: Environment growth modifiers: radiated=0.10×, toxic=0.20×, inferno=0.20×, dead=0.30×, barren=0.40×, tundra=0.50×
mismatches.actual_impl: ENV_GROWTH_MODIFIER has slight differences: radiated=0.1 (matches), toxic=0.2 (matches), inferno=0.2 (matches), dead=0.3 (matches), tundra=0.5 (matches), barren=0.4 (matches). All match.

mismatches.design_spec: Environment capacity modifiers: radiated=0.20×, toxic=0.30×, inferno=0.30×, dead=0.40×, barren=0.50×, tundra=0.60×
mismatches.actual_impl: ENV_CAPACITY_MODIFIER: radiated=0.2 (matches), toxic=0.3 (matches), inferno=0.3 (matches), dead=0.4 (matches), barren=0.5 (matches), tundra=0.6 (matches). All match.

mismatches.design_spec: Operating Factories: Population operates factories at a ratio determined by Robotic Controls technology: Base: 2 factories per population. With tech upgrades: Up to 7 factories per population
mismatches.actual_impl: roboticControlsLevel in DEFAULT_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT is 2, which matches base. The comment says 'up to 7' but there's no validation that enforces a max of 7.
mismatches.recommendation: Add a MAX_ROBOTIC_CONTROLS_LEVEL = 7 constant and clamp the value in operatingFactories() or context creation.

mismatches.design_spec: Display Text: `(Ship Name) & Turns` (e.g., 'Scout 4') for ship slider
mismatches.actual_impl: getBuildingDescription() returns 'SHIP' when shipyardProgress > 0, not the actual ship name and turns remaining
mismatches.recommendation: Enhance getBuildingDescription() to lookup ship design name and calculate turns remaining from shipyardProgress vs total cost.

mismatches.actual_impl: calculatePlanetProduction() uses simplified formula: factories * 1.0 + population * 0.5, but doesn't apply mineral richness, racial modifiers, or factory efficiency multipliers.
mismatches.recommendation: Use the full calculateNetProduction() from production.ts instead of simplified inline calculation, or note this is intentionally simplified for list view performance.

mismatches.design_spec: Star Gates: Cost: 3000 BC, Tech Required: Intergalactic Star Gates (Propulsion), Effect: Instant travel between gated planets
mismatches.actual_impl: Star Gate building is referenced in design but implementation relies on buildings.json data file (not reviewed in this scope). No explicit Star Gate handling logic in buildings.ts.
mismatches.recommendation: Verify buildings.json contains star_gate entry with correct cost (3000 BC) and tech requirement. Add Star Gate effect processing in fleet movement system.

missing_from_code.feature: Rush Production: Pay extra BC to complete projects instantly at 2× remaining BC cost
Planetary Governors: AI manages sliders for casual play
Population Transport: Transport population between colonies using transport ships
Invasion ground combat: Transport population to enemy planets for ground combat
Conquered Populations: Morale penalty and production reduction until stabilized
Population voting: Council votes proportional to population for diplomatic victory
Guardian ship combat: Must defeat Guardian before colonizing Orion - no guardian battle implementation visible
Artifacts World one-time tech bonus: First empire to colonize receives a random technology
Stellar Converter planet destruction: Transforms habitable planet into asteroid field
Terraforming environment upgrade: Some advanced techs can improve environment type (e.g., barren → minimal)

not_in_design.feature: Stellar Converter gas giant conversion: convertGasGiantToTerran() converts gas giants to terran worlds after 50 turns. Design mentions Stellar Converter destroys planets but doesn't specify gas giant terraforming.
canBuildStellarConverter() restricts Stellar Converter to gas giants only. Design doesn't specify this restriction.
NEBULA_CAPACITY_BONUS = 15: Nebula systems grant +15 population capacity. Not found in planets design docs (may be in galaxy generation docs).
Soil enrichment levels (0/1/2) with +25/+50 population bonus. Not found in planets design docs.
Morale modifier formula: 0.5 + (morale / 200). Design mentions morale affects conquered planets but doesn't specify this formula.
Food/farming system: processFoodAndStarvation(), farmers, ENV_FERTILITY. Design docs for planets mention no separate food system ('❌ Farms/Hydroponic facilities (no separate food system)').
Planetology TL scaling for population labor output: basePopOutput() scales from 0.5 to 2.0 BC based on planetologyTL 0-50. Design says 0.5 BC fixed.
Factory efficiency multiplier (factoryEfficiencyMultiplier) for races like Mice. Referenced in code but not in planets design docs.
TRANSFER_BC action for moving credits from empire reserve to planet production. Not specified in planets production design.
